summary: Credentialed SIEM field-scan and redaction test bundle for SOC2 evidence
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a credentialed field-mapping scan against a sample 24-hour audit slice and a redaction demonstration bundle for SOC2 auditors. Impact: Aureus needs an auditable sample package that demonstrates per-tenant PII redaction, signed delivery manifest, and a verification checklist to present to their external auditor on 2025-02-25. Environment: production audit stream (tenant: aureus-prod) in us-east-1. Desired delivery: (1) 24-hour compact event slice (gzipped, PARQUET preferred) with tenant pseudonymization toggled off for demonstration and a parallel redacted copy, (2) signed manifest with per-file SHA256 checksums and signer identity, (3) short runbook describing the redaction rules applied and reversible pseudonymization proof steps, (4) live credentialed scan results showing field presence/absence for auditor-specified fields. Customer provided the auditor CSV of required fields in an initial email attachment.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - evidence generation request rather than a reproducible bug

Produce two bundles: raw-sample.parquet.gz and redacted-sample.parquet.gz
Generate manifest.json with SHA256 and sign using current KMS key: projects/redwood/kms/keys/evidence-signing-prod
Run credentialed field-scan (scanner v1.9.2) with auditor-supplied schema and capture summary report
Upload artifacts to the pre-arranged Aureus SFTP endpoint and provide delivery receipts
